title: Power and the night
summary: Solar works by day; batteries carry you through the night. The cryo bank comes first.
text:
Every building draws power, and the **cryo bank** draws it before anything else. The ⚡ readout shows what you make against what you use.

**Solar Arrays** make power by day only: at night they give a trickle. Store the day's spare power in **Batteries** (🔋) to get through the dark.

- Build a Battery before your first night
- Geothermal Plants on a vent give steady power, day and night
- When the batteries run dry, buildings brown out: guns stop and the cryo bank loses integrity
